subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should newly collected persona TTS SecretRefs follow the current required/fail-fast activation contract immediately, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This patch correctly expands a security credential boundary, but doing so can turn previously ignored missing persona credentials into Gateway startup failures; repository history and existing documentation establish fail-fast behavior, while the linked work proposes a deliberate exception.

options.title: Preserve fail-fast
options.body: Land the corrected and proven collector under the existing SecretRef contract, treating missing active persona TTS credentials as activation errors while the broader optional-TTS policy remains separate.

options.title: Sequence after degradation
options.body: Hold this PR until the optional TTS missing-secret behavior is accepted and landed, avoiding a temporary upgrade window where persona refs can block startup.

recommendation.title: Preserve fail-fast
recommendation.body: Land the corrected and proven collector under the existing SecretRef contract, treating missing active persona TTS credentials as activation errors while the broader optional-TTS policy remains separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The original external-secrets implementation and runtime activation contract originated in their merged feature work.
